## Overview

Union members at United Videogame Workers-CWA (UVW-CWA) have established the Game Worker Hardship Fund, a program offering direct cash grants to video game developers in the United States and Canada who have lost their jobs or otherwise been affected by the wave of layoffs sweeping the industry, according to [Game Developer](https://www.gamedeveloper.com/business/union-workers-establish-hardship-fund-to-support-devs-impacted-by-layoffs). editor_notes.content_quality: Well-structured Briefing (528 words, within the 300-800 range) using the standard Overview / What We Know / What We Don't Know / Analysis format. Clear, neutral prose. The Analysis section appropriately frames the fund as an escalation in organized labor's response to industry layoffs without editorializing, and the 'What We Don't Know' section honestly flags that neither source discloses application volume or funds distributed so far.
editor_notes.source_verification: Personally read both source snapshots from sources/2026-07/game-workers-union-launches-hardship-fund-offering-up-to-5000-to-developers-hit-by-industry-layoffs/ after independently recomputing sha256 of each decompressed .html.gz against manifest.json (both matched exactly; both fetched with HTTP 200, no archive_fallback needed). (1) source-0 (gamedeveloper.com, byline Chris Kerr, published July 2, 2026) confirms: the fund's establishment by UVW-CWA union members; the 'lost their jobs (or been impacted in other ways)' language (article quotes this verbatim in quote marks); the $1,000 / $1,000-$5,000 grant tiers; the groceries/medical bills/rent eligible-expense list; that non-members may apply but only members' dues finance the fund; the Necrosoft Games (Demonschool developer) itch.io bundle detail; and the full block quote describing the application process, which is reproduced verbatim in the article. (2) source-1 (uvw-cwa.org/hardship-fund-2026, the union's own official page) independently confirms the same application-process block quote verbatim, the 'within the timeframe of January 2024 to the present' quote verbatim, the non-member eligibility, the membership-dues financing model, and the Necrosoft Games itch.io bundle. All 2 body-markdown links match the article.sources array exactly; no orphan URLs. The only automated finding was that uvw-cwa.org was not yet present in config/source_allowlist.txt. Having personally verified this is the union's genuine official site (consistent branding/navigation, matches the content gamedeveloper.com explicitly attributes to 'the union's own site', and is corroborated word-for-word by the allowlisted secondary source), I added uvw-cwa.org to the allowlist as part of this review (see 'BATCH ADDITIONS — 2026-07-12' in config/source_allowlist.txt), following the same precedent set in the 2026-07-10 Echoes of Aincrad review.
